method: Retrospective replay of saved PyMuPDF4LLM outputs; no fresh inference, model fitting, score change, or manual repair of parser output.
primary_contract: Correct numeric content, separately bound row and column, and usable unit context. Multiple source rows inside one HTML cell do not pass without a separate repair step.
score: Existing out-of-document-family association diagnostic output, uncalibrated. Low < 0.5; high >= 0.5, for descriptive selection only. Numeric scores are reported separately and missing scores stay missing.
selection: Four low-score errors and two high-score errors selected from existing labels and scores; two high-score correct controls substitute for the absent low-score fully-correct stratum. This is an illustrative, deliberately selected case study, not an estimated recovery rate for new documents.

samples.note: Source p3: total revenue, electricity supply / domestic, GBP millions, 3,037.1. Original row label and unit span three concepts. Retry isolates Total revenue, its unit, and the two-level column header.

Source p3 shows separate revenue-from-sales and other-revenues rows: 3,037.1 and 0.0. Retry inserts an explicit HTML line break between the numbers, but both row labels and both units still occupy one cell. Numeric content improves; no separate financial records are produced.
Source p3: revenue-from-sales 8,674.9; other revenues 0.0. Retry preserves both numbers with a line break, but the two rows and units remain bundled. It fails the same strict contract as B.
Source p3: revenue-from-sales 1,693.1; other revenues 0.0. Retry preserves both numbers with a line break, but the two rows and units remain bundled. It fails the same strict contract as B.
